name: Giant Bat
description: A giant bat is a massive, winged mammal with keen senses and an intimidating presence. It is most active at night, using its echolocation to hunt and navigate through dark environments.

actions.name: Fanged Bite
actions.description: The giant bat bites a creature with its fangs, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Sonic Screech
actions.description: The giant bat lets loose a deafening screech in an attempt to disorient creatures, causing all affected creatures to have a 1d4 penalty to all defense and attack checks until the end of their next turn. This action can only be used once per engagement.

actions.name: Swoop
actions.description: While flying, the giant bat swoops down towards a creature within 3 units and returns to its original position. The giant bat has a 1d4 bonus to any defense checks against reactions provoked by this movement. The giant bat can also use 1 action during this movement.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description: The bat has an echolocation of up to 20 units and suffers a 1d4 penalty to sonic attacks. The bat also gains a 1d4 bonus to search checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Active Flight
traits.description: The giant bat must spend at least 1 action per round to maintain their height while flying, otherwise, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.
